title: Admit each task-sync command once and reuse its read-only data-worktree selection
outcome: Reduce repeated full data-worktree admissions within task-sync commands while retaining existing checks immediately before effects.
acceptance: One command admits its data-worktree selection once and passes that operation-local state through read-only phases; standalone readers retain their admission contract, with no global cache or deadline change
Existing write, commit and push owners still revalidate immediately before effects; stale selection, unsafe paths, changed files and competing history continue to refuse without unintended mutation

A real per-command Git-start regression covers refusal and representative successful paths without growth from unrelated files; focused Windows checks and independent whole-input reviews cover the exact implementation
